seoTitle: How to Connect DHL to Shopify With Express Commerce
metaDescription: Set up DHL shipping in Shopify using the DHL Express Commerce app to configure rates and simplify domestic and international orders.
intro: Shipping internationally or domestically with DHL becomes much easier once it's connected directly to your Shopify store. This guide covers how to install the DHL Express Commerce app, connect it as a shipping carrier, and configure rates inside Shopify.

steps.heading: Install the DHL Express Commerce app
steps.body: Search the Shopify App Store for DHL Express Commerce and add it to your store.

steps.heading: Connect your DHL account
steps.body: Link your existing DHL Express account credentials through the app's setup process.

steps.heading: Configure DHL as a shipping carrier
steps.body: Enable DHL within your Shopify shipping settings so it appears as an available carrier option.

steps.heading: Set up shipping rates
steps.body: Configure the specific DHL rates and services you want to offer customers at checkout.

steps.heading: Test your setup
steps.body: Place a test order to make sure DHL rates calculate correctly for both domestic and international shipments.

faq.question: Do I need my own DHL Express account?
faq.answer: Yes, you need an active DHL Express account before you can connect it through the app to your Shopify store.

faq.question: Can I ship internationally with this integration?
faq.answer: Yes, DHL is well known for international shipping, and the Express Commerce app supports both domestic and cross-border shipments.

faq.question: Is the DHL Express Commerce app free?
faq.answer: App pricing can vary, so check the current listing in the Shopify App Store for exact plan details and any free tier.

faq.question: Will shipping labels be generated automatically?
faq.answer: The app typically lets you generate DHL shipping labels for your orders directly, though the exact workflow depends on your configuration.
